name: MAgIC
description: MAgIC is a competition-based benchmark framework designed to evaluate large language models in multi-agent environments, focusing on reasoning, planning, collaboration, judgment, deception, self-awareness, cooperation, coordination, and rationality. It uses social deduction games and game-theory scenarios to create diverse evaluation settings.
reputation: A well-known research benchmark for multi-agent LLM evaluation, frequently cited in work on social deduction, cooperation, and strategic reasoning.
notes: Includes probabilistic graphic modeling (PGM) to enhance LLM capabilities; evaluates social and cognitive dimensions in multi-agent settings.
